item.title: 🚀 Introducing XREAL 1 Pro+
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded:
🚀 Introducing XREAL 1 Pro+
XREAL One Pro set the bar. XREAL 1 Pro+ raises it.
Building on everything that made the XREAL One Pro stand out, XREAL 1 Pro+ takes the experience further with brighter visuals, more immersive 3D, and refined comfort.
✨ Brighter, more vivid visuals: 1,200 nits of perceived brightness and AI HDR bring greater clarity and detail to your content.

Feel the Difference.

item.title: Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
item.dc:creator: pimaxofficial
item.content:encoded:
Pimax Crystal Pro. Wireless Native Foveated Streaming.
With eye tracking, Crystal Pro dynamically sends the native GPU signal to your focus area through 60G Airlink, without additional codec or compression. The focus zone updates frame by frame as your gaze moves.
DisplayPort-grade quality. Wirelessly.
✅ Native GPU signal in your focus area ✅ Dynamic frame-by-frame foveated streaming ✅ 6+ Gbps through two MIMO paths ✅ Under 2ms added latency ✅ XR2 chip for frame synchronization ✅ Wi-Fi fallback + Pimax Play management ✅ Airlink Pro mode with ~10 Gbps combined bandwidth
Learn more: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lhJ5d1qS5cM https://x.com/pimaxofficial/status/2108935587537231983/video/1

item.dc:creator: getVITURE
item.content:encoded:
We’re thrilled to welcome @benz145 to VITURE! Ben brings a wealth of XR expertise and a deep understanding of the community shaping its future. Thank you for your trust, Ben, we can’t wait to build what’s next together!
And congratulations to @vrbosenet on his new role at @RtoVR!
引用 @benz145： I have news.
Longtime editor @vrbosenet is the new Executive Editor of @RtoVR!
I’m stepping back from editorial to the role of Business Director to focus on reader experience and platform. I have also joined @getVITURE as Head of Strategic Partnerships.
With the Executive Editorship in Scott’s hands—and a contractual agreement that VITURE cannot attempt to influence Road to VR by using my position as leverage—I’m confident that Road to VR will retain the editorial independence that we’ve worked to maintain over all these years.
